A Psalm-song--(see on <reference osisRef="Ps.30.1">Psa 30:1</reference>, title). The theme: God should be praised for His righteous judgments on the wicked and His care and defense of His people. entries.content_plain: PSALM 92 Psa 92:1-15 . A Psalm-song--(see on Psa 30:1 , title). The theme: God should be praised for His righteous judgments on the wicked and His care and defense of His people. Such a topic, at all times proper, is specially so for the reflections of the Sabbath day. 1. sing ... name-- celebrate Thy perfections.

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6579"/><div sID="gen10082" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6579"/><hi type="bold">2. in the morning, ... every night--</hi>diligently and constantly (<reference osisRef="Ps.42.8">Psa 42:8</reference>).<div eID="gen10082" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen10083" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">loving kindness--</hi>literally, "mercy."<div eID="gen10083" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen10084" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">faithfulness--</hi>in fulfilling promises (<reference osisRef="Ps.89.14">Psa 89:14</reference>). <div eID="gen10084" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 2. in the morning, ... every night-- diligently and constantly ( Psa 42:8 ). loving kindness-- literally, "mercy." faithfulness-- in fulfilling promises ( Psa 89:14 ).
entries.reader_content_plain: 2. in the morning, ... every night-- diligently and constantly ( Psa 42:8 ). loving kindness-- literally, "mercy." faithfulness-- in fulfilling promises ( Psa 89:14 ).
